Virtual Medical Front Desk

A Real Front Desk Team, Just Not in Your Waiting Room

A missed call from a patient is rarely just one missed call. It's a booking that goes to a competitor, a follow-up that never happens, or a referral that quietly falls through because no one picked up in time. A single front-desk staff member juggling phones, check-ins and paperwork cannot answer every call the moment it comes in, especially during peak hours, lunch breaks, or when someone calls in sick.

PMEX's virtual medical front desk is a dedicated team of trained staff, not a bot reading from a generic script, who answer calls, manage your entire appointment book, handle registration and insurance intake, and route anything urgent straight to your in-office clinical team. They work inside your own scheduling system and EHR, using your practice's own greeting, tone and policies, so a patient calling in has no idea whether the person on the line is sitting in your building or somewhere else entirely.

This is where appointment management actually happens at PMEX. Scheduling, rescheduling, confirmations, reminders, cancellations and waitlist fills are all handled by this same trained team, not by an automated system left to run on its own.

What's Included

  • ✓Incoming call answering and routing, 24/7 or during set hours
  • ✓Full appointment management: booking, rescheduling, cancellations
  • ✓New patient registration and intake
  • ✓Insurance information collection and eligibility flagging
  • ✓Referral coordination, incoming and outgoing
  • ✓Prescription refill request routing
  • ✓Message routing to the right in-office staff or provider
  • ✓Urgent call triage and escalation
  • ✓Text, email and web chat handling alongside phone calls
  • ✓Bilingual support for English and Spanish-speaking patients
  • ✓After-hours, weekend and overflow call coverage
  • ✓HIPAA-compliant call and message handling
